method.description: build.mjs fetches the 59 site files (2498385 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source, 8 in flight, 30 s timeout per request) at the pinned commit b19a15d and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public. The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20, v20.1, v20.2 and v20.3 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (HEAD == origin/main == b19a15d, clean tree, blobs cross-checked against the working tree, 0 mismatches) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying with Node 22 (59/59 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com in 1.3 s and byte-identical to the checkout, no extraneous output files), together with a negative test (one tampered hash -> the build aborts with exit 1 after 58/59) and a fallback test (raw host unreachable -> all 59 files come from cdn.jsdelivr.net, still byte-identical). The Vercel build finished in under two minutes; the raw deployment URL served the verified v20.4 index at the first poll (11:24:44Z) and the public alias followed at 11:24:53Z.

notes: The repository is public (gh: visibility PUBLIC), which is what makes the pinned-commit fetch possible; the ~2.5 MB site tree (59 files, 2498385 B) was therefore not inlined into the MCP request.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints (get_deployment_build_logs with the known team id returns 404 'Deployment not found' for this token) were not usable, so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.
The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened.

The tabbar spot check asked for by the task (CSS opacity) was done twice: statically in the served index.html (background:var(--soot) with --soot:#0B0908, no backdrop-filter, no gradient, no transform) and dynamically with headless Chrome on the live URL (computed background-color rgb(11, 9, 8), opacity 1, backdrop-filter none, background-image none, position fixed and pinned to the viewport bottom before and after scrolling).
README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json and docs/ stay out of the deployment as before; ATTRIBUTIONS.md (unchanged) stays in.
No app code was changed for this deploy; this commit updates DEPLOY_RESULT.json only.
